title: Adding One More Agent: How AI Team Size and Formation Shape Productivity and Diversity in Human-AI Brainstorming Teams
description_en: arXiv:2611.26663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative AI has improved individual productivity, but whether adding a plurality of AI partners helps or hurts remains open. We crossed AI partnership (one versus two) with behavioral formation (calibrated to average human behavior versus customized by the participant) in a brainstorming experiment ($N$=168) with human-human dyads as reference. Two-AI rooms posted more ideas to the shared board, but human-authored ideas dropped substantially. With one AI partner, formation mattered: humans paired with an average-calibrated AI posted more than any other condition. With two, this effect vanished. Start with a script, image, or video clip, then direct the scenes, add player choices, and create branching storylines with different outcomes. AI helps bring everything together into an interactive experience you can share. It's more like directing your own interactive movie than programming a game.

It reads each subreddit's rules, writes a reply that helps, and posts it from your own account at a human pace. Say yes to each reply, or turn on autopilot. No Reddit account? title: Gauth Personal Study Agent
description_en: An AI study agent that remembers where you struggle. Gauth Personal Study Agent connects the questions you snap, the quizzes you take, and the topics you study into one ongoing picture of how you learn. Instead of starting from scratch each session, it spots the gap behind a mistake, builds a short daily plan around it, and adjusts that plan when you miss a review or master a topic early. Practice comes as flashcards, guided step-by-step walkthroughs, and quizzes, with topic mastery and streaks to show progress. Built into the Gauth app.

title: Resurf
description_en: Personal Knowledge Base & Bookmark Manager for Mac. A fully local personal context library for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Save notes, links, images, and documents. Hand off context to AI through MCP or the CLI on Mac.

title: Modem
description_en: Find, fix, and follow up on every customer concern. Modem monitors your customer channels (support tickets, group chat, sales calls) and alerts you to problems within minutes. It can automatically open an issue, spin up a coding agent, or escalate to the right team. When the fix ships, it closes the loop with your customers. Never lose track of a request again.

title: Dog Translator SuperTranslator
description_en: Dogs talking in English (real). What if your dog could tell you what they're feeling? SuperTranslator uses AI to read your dog's body language, vocalizations and interactions with their surroundings, and turns those signals into plain English. Instead of random phrases from barks, it looks at several behavioral cues at once to help you understand what your dog might be communicating. According to our benchmarks, this is the most accurate dog translation in history.

title: oovi
description_en: Your own team of AI on your desktop. Hand oovi a job and a team of AI bots does it: a leader plans, a researcher digs, a writer drafts, a critic checks. Watch each bot work, and approve anything before it goes out. Free with your own AI key, or from $10/mo with credits that never expire.

title: Polylane Swarms
description_en: A team of AI agents on your roughest production incidents. Put a swarm of agents on your massive production incidents. Agents investigate possible causes in parallel, share evidence and check each other's findings. You get one answer with the root cause, the evidence and a proposed fix.

title: Webless Agents
description_en: Agents you want to put in front of customers. You wouldn’t put most website chatbots in front of a customer. Webless Agents are different: you describe the outcome you want in plain English, and Webless builds the agent on your published content, so it answers only from what you’ve said. You review every instruction and change anything before it goes live. Then it gets to work: answering questions, qualifying buyers, sending quotes, booking meetings and handing off to your team. For Product Hunt: 3 months of our highest plan, free.

title: Chat with Work
description_en: AI bots in Europe. They work. You decide.. Create a bot with a single sentence. It works for you. Create as many as you need. They start by themselves and work across 1,920+ integrations with your laptop closed. When there's a decision to take, they ask you. Every question and approval from all your bots lands in one place. You just decide. Claude Duet: US only. ChatGPT's dots: not on Pro or Plus in Europe. Gemini's Tasks: not in Europe. Not us. Chat with Work's bots run in the EU, on every plan. 300 trial credits, no card.

title: Inkling 2 Mini
description_en: 26B looped model for coding on your laptop. Inkling 2 Mini is Thinking Machines' 26.4B open-weight model built for local agentic work. Its middle transformer layers run three times per token, adding reasoning depth without extra weights. It runs on 32GB Macs through Ollama.

title: Hydrilla
description_en: Generate production-ready 3D assets with AI. Hydrilla AI generates high-quality 3D assets from simple prompts. Designed for game developers, animation studios, and XR creators, it helps teams create production-ready models in minutes instead of days. Build faster pipelines for games, films, and immersive worlds.

title: Omi CLI
description_en: AI coding agents that work while you're away.. Omi can build anything. Give Omi a coding task and let it get to work: it reads your repo, fixes bugs, runs tests, and uses a real browser to check your app. Parallel subagents tackle tasks in separate worktrees. Background agents keep going after you close the terminal; cloud agents can open PRs. Review changes as diffs, undo mistakes, and choose from 13 models or bring your own. Free to start: npm i -g @builditomi/cli

title: Ulika
description_en: Visual editor for sites built with Claude, Cursor, or Codex. AI can ship a React, Vite, or Next site in a weekend. Then marketing wants a headline change and opens a ticket. Ulika connects the site so anyone can edit copy and images on the page and publish, without touching code. Open beta, free to try at ulika.co.

title: LeanTake
description_en: 4.1 MB native Mac screen recorder — zero export wait. Pure Swift + ScreenCaptureKit screen recorder for macOS 15+ (Apple Silicon). Real-time hardware encoding writes finishedmov videos the second you hit Stop. Includes a 12-color live pen, region magnifier, 9 3D cat paw cursors, and a window-excluded stealth teleprompter. Free forever (no watermark, no login); optional Pro $14.99 one-time.

title: Plango
description_en: Plango lets your AI agents work all night - safely. AI is wreaking havoc in cybersecurity. You need a command center to protect your device and AI-agent setup. There are two major risks today: 1. External AI attackers finding exploits 2. Internal AI taking unsafe actions Plango researches and patches vulnerabilities while running entirely on-device. It finds where you're vulnerable and shows how to fix it. (example: you may be vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks due to SSL certs compromised in October. Plango shows if you have them!)

title: Wispim
description_en: The teleprompter that follows your voice. Wispim listens and follows the words you actually say. Pause, and it waits. Speed up, and it keeps up. The script floats over Instagram, TikTok or your camera while you record. iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and Windows, and free in your browser.

Ready-made teammates, scheduled tasks and voice mode. Teams get roles, SSO and an audit log. Free to start, no card.

title: Othor AI
description_en: Your Head of Intelligence. Know what your numbers are hiding. Othor AI is a new species of business intelligence, built on the tradecraft of intelligence agencies and a century of signal analysis. Automated statistical intelligence for business leaders: more signal, faster decisions, with the smallest possible AI bill and the least human effort. AI drafts the words; code computes every number, and any night can be replayed byte for byte. Open source (Apache-2.0); hosted or on your servers.

title: 30yr-uptime
description_en: Claude Code mod for taking care of your body. A Claude Code mod that turns waiting on Claude into movement breaks. Every 45 min, when a turn runs past 15s, a pixel character acts out one of 16 moves for your neck, back, hips, legs, wrists, eyes or lungs. Done, In 5 min or Skip. Local, zero tokens.

title: Ashwa
description_en: Your AI companion that never forgets what you say. Come back after 100 days, and Ashwa can still recall relevant details from your past conversations and diary entries. Pick up where you left off without repeating your story. Talk through your day, reflect in a private daily journal, and get responses shaped by the emotional context you've shared

title: TeaserKit
description_en: your coding agent directs your launch video. TeaserKit is the director for your coding agent's videos. Installed in one line, it makes Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents direct a launch video, ad or explainer from your repo or website: a concept, a house style, a human-made song cut to the beat and a quality check before the final render. Includes a local Studio app. One-time purchase.

title: Zapyso
description_en: Free meeting notes and dictation that stay on your Mac. Zapyso records your calls on the Mac itself, with no bot joining, and writes a transcript and a summary with decisions and next steps. It notices calls in Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Slack and more. Hold the right ⌘ key to dictate into any app. Speech recognition and summaries run on-device, so recordings and notes never leave your Mac. No account. Free, on Mac and iPhone. Needs Apple silicon and macOS 15.

title: Mobile Agent Testers
description_en: Free open-source AI agents that beta-test your app on phones. No test scripts. Each tester is an AI agent with its own Android emulator or iOS Simulator on GitHub Actions, playing a persona: iPhone SE in Swedish at the largest text size, Pixel 7 at 200%, iPad in German, Arabic right to left. It uses your app like a new user and writes a bug report with screenshots, then one summary groups the duplicates. Open source. Flutter, React Native, Expo, Kotlin, Swift, KMP, Capacitor,NET MAUI, or a prebuilt APK.

title: Orpheus
description_en: Run all your Claude subscriptions from one place. Orpheus puts every Claude subscription you pay for on one board: weekly and 5-hour usage, forecast and reset. Move idle agents to the account with room, answer agents on every machine, and open Rooms where your team and your agents chat together.

title: Open Source Solana Wallet
description_en: Your own keys, your very own network. A Solana wallet for iPhone and iPad with no backend. It connects directly to the RPC you choose: public Solana RPC, a provider with your own key, or any HTTPS URL. - Private balances for SOL, USDC, and USDT - Only the tokens you add, so no spam - Prices in your currency, from the built-in source, your own server, or none - Built-in themes, or build your own theme pack - Several windows on iPad and iPhone Duo - Open source

title: DeNotch
description_en: Hide the MacBook notch and tame your menu bar. DeNotch hides the MacBook notch behind a black bar that works on any wallpaper, dynamic and Aerial ones included, and never edits your files. It tidies your menu bar too: hide icons behind ⌄, put them where you want, and show apps only while they matter, like your VPN while it's connected. Beside the notch, a pill holds live widgets (CPU, battery, network, a timer, now playing, GitHub, AI usage limits) and a cat. Free during the beta, for macOS 26 and later.

title: Squint
description_en: Explains whatever you're looking at, now on Mac. Now on Mac. Press a hotkey, drag a box around anything on your screen, and the answer starts streaming in beside it within moments. No switching apps, no chat window. Also new since the first launch: answers in your own language, one-press copy to hand a capture to your coding agent, and a Microsoft Store install. Windows and Linux too. Free plan, no card.

title: FigmaMCP
description_en: Let Claude Code or Codex edit your open Figma file. A free Mac app and Figma plugin that let Claude Code or Codex read and edit the file open in Figma desktop. No Figma API token, no call quota. The app installs the plugin and connects your agent. One switch makes the file read-only.

title: MAI Image 2.7
description_en: Microsoft's image model with precise edits and Canvas. MAI Image 2.7 and MAI Image 2.7 Flash are Microsoft AI's image generation and editing models. They change an object's color, material or position without disturbing the rest, and output transparent backgrounds for logos and product images. Canvas, powered by Flash, turns prompts and sketches into editable images. Per Microsoft, 2.7 ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis image editing. Public preview on Foundry at about $35 and $10 per 1,000 images.

title: Perfstaq
description_en: Are you a top 1% developer? Prove it in one command. Anyone can claim 5 years of TypeScript. Perfstaq lets you prove it. One command reads your own git history and your Claude Code, Cursor and Codex sessions, on your laptop. Your code never leaves it. Then GitHub spot-checks your commits at random to prove they're really yours. You get your exact standing (Top 1%, 2%, 3%…), cards made to share, and a link any client can verify in 5 seconds. Free, with an open-source scanner.

title: Dreamwork
description_en: The job search agent that only applies where you fit. Dreamwork reads your resume and matches you against millions of live roles. Tap Apply and it writes a fully editable resume and cover letter for that role, then fills out the employer's application directly. Add writing samples to keep your voice. You can turn on autopilot and have it apply overnight, or you can edit each submission with granular detail. The choice is yours. Matching and tailored applications are free. No ads, and no employer can pay to rank higher.
